comment: What a failed run's plain error text means: signedOut (not signed in, signed out, an expired or rejected login), limitReached (a usage or rate limit), keyRejected (the provider rejected graff's API key, or the key it fell back to after a plan ran out; the sign-in is fine), or null for anything else. Matching is case-insensitive on substrings, and a curly apostrophe reads as a straight one. keyRejected is checked first ("api key was rejected", "fallback api key", "sign-in is not affected"), before everything else, so a provider named like GitHub Copilot still reads as its key. Otherwise hosted credit, GitHub's own API and Harness's own account are never the provider's problem, and a signedOut match wins over limitReached. graff's older generic "provider authentication failed: sign in again or check the API key" can't say which credential failed and stays signedOut, as does Claude Code's "Invalid API key · Please run /login". Provider-typed reauthentication keeps its own card and is not classified here. The desktop (crates/proto/src/run_errors.rs) and the phone (RunErrors.swift) check these same cases.
